objective: At the exact 48 frozen M55 states, reconstruct the complete source-, drain-, and substrate-associated DopingWells boundary flux from exported nodal carrier-current density and test whether terminal-oriented full-well surface flux plus the frozen well-volume SRH charge term closes the Sentaurus default terminal carrier current.

upstream.orientation_anchor: M49/M50 establish that geometric outward exported contact-face flux is the negative of Sentaurus terminal orientation; M52 establishes DirectCurrent as the native physical-contact surface anchor.
closed_topics: M51 CurrentWeighting and M52 DirectCurrent six-state attribution
M55 contact-associated doping-well topology and SRH attribution

fixed_state_policy.source_states: the exact existing M55 exported states and terminal/SRH ledgers
allowed_operations: read existing M55 nodes, Silicon triangles, contacts, DopingWells, eCurrentDensity, and hCurrentDensity
read frozen M55 default, DirectCurrent, and signed well-SRH ledger values
perform deterministic geometric reconstruction and write analysis artifacts

boundary_reconstruction.well_label_rule: The named contact well label is the unique integer DopingWells value on every Silicon node of that contact; it must equal the frozen M55 seed-derived well index.
boundary_reconstruction.unassociated_wells: Integer DopingWells labels not associated with source, drain, or substrate remain distinct neighboring partitions and are never merged into a terminal-associated well.
boundary_reconstruction.interior_interface_rule: For a Silicon triangle containing exactly two DopingWells labels, the partition interface is the segment joining the midpoints of its two unlike-label edges. Nodal current density is linearly interpolated to those midpoints.
boundary_reconstruction.uniform_triangle_rule: A Silicon triangle whose three vertices share a label is wholly assigned to that label.
boundary_reconstruction.exterior_edge_rule: A Silicon exterior edge with equal endpoint labels belongs wholly to that label; an unlike-label exterior edge is split at its midpoint between the endpoint labels.
boundary_reconstruction.normal_rule: Every reconstructed segment uses a unit normal pointing geometrically outward from the named well partition, selected from local triangle geometry without state-, device-, contact-, or component-dependent sign fitting.
boundary_reconstruction.quadrature_rule: Use the trapezoidal average of linearly interpolated endpoint current-density vectors on each straight segment.
boundary_reconstruction.normalization_rule: Current density in A/cm2 times segment length in um times 1e-8 yields 2-D current in A/um.
boundary_reconstruction.terminal_orientation_rule: terminal-oriented carrier surface current equals negative geometric outward carrier flux for every state, contact, and carrier.
boundary_reconstruction.closure_formula: default terminal carrier current = negative complete geometric outward associated-well boundary flux + frozen signed associated-well SRH charge current
boundary_reconstruction.direct_anchor_formula: DirectCurrent terminal carrier current = negative geometric outward physical-contact flux

controls: matched low-NWell n19 at Vg=0.00, 0.05, and 0.10 V
all eight devices, both drain voltages, and all three low-gate states

classifications.full_doping_well_boundary_closure: The DopingWells partition is unambiguous, every reconstructed physical-contact carrier flux matches its DirectCurrent anchor, and every complete-well surface-plus-SRH carrier prediction closes the default terminal current within the frozen tolerances.
classifications.boundary_quadrature_limited: The DopingWells partition is unambiguous, but one or more exported nodal physical-contact reconstructions fail the DirectCurrent anchor tolerance, so the same nodal quadrature cannot decisively test complete-well closure.
classifications.doping_well_partition_ambiguous: A contact label is non-unique, a label is non-integer, a Silicon triangle contains more than two labels, or the midpoint partition cannot form the required deterministic boundary.
classifications.closure_mismatch: The DopingWells partition is unambiguous and all physical-contact anchors pass, but one or more complete-well surface-plus-SRH predictions fail to close the default terminal carrier current.
classifications.upstream_state_mismatch: A frozen M55 report, state count, ledger count, contact-well index, topology invariance, or upstream hash check fails.

analysis.claim_guard: M57 tests one explicitly frozen reconstruction of the exported nodal DopingWells partition. Failure to close does not prove a Sentaurus defect or authorize a Vela production change; it identifies either exported-field quadrature limitation or a mismatch between this reconstruction and Sentaurus's internal default terminal integration surface.

forbidden_work: HFS, SG, quasi-Fermi, BGN, SRH-model, mobility, contact-model, mesh, electrode, solve-path, or production-default changes
device-specific, bias-specific, state-specific, contact-specific, or carrier-specific normal/sign fitting
merging unassociated DopingWells labels into a terminal well
changing reconstruction rules, tolerances, or classifications after freezing the contract
required_artifacts: frozen contract and upstream hash manifest
machine-readable report, evidence manifest, regression test, and human-readable report
